t2.title: Teaching art and music in schools
t2.prompt:
You are participating in an online discussion for students and teachers.

The question is:

"Do schools still need to teach art and music subjects?"

Post your response, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample: The question of whether arts and music should remain core components of the school curriculum is a perennial debate, but I firmly believe their role is more critical than ever. In an era increasingly dominated by STEM, the arts provide an indispensable counterbalance, fostering skills that are not easily quantifiable but are vital for holistic development. Firstly, subjects like music, drama, and visual arts are fundamental to nurturing creativity and critical thinking. They teach students to interpret the world through different lenses, to solve problems with no single correct answer, and to innovate. For example, a student learning to improvise in a jazz ensemble is developing cognitive flexibility and collaborative skills that are eminently transferable to any professional field. Secondly, the arts are a powerful medium for cultural understanding and emotional expression. They provide a space for students to explore their own identity and to develop empathy by engaging with the perspectives of others from different eras and cultures. This cultivation of emotional intelligence is arguably as important as academic prowess. While some may argue that these subjects are luxuries in a results-driven educational system, I contend they are necessities. They equip students not just to find jobs, but to lead fulfilling and meaningful lives.
t2.sampleA1: Some people think art and music are not important at school. But I do not agree. Art and music are fun. They help students to be creative and happy. Maths is important too. But school is not only exams. I think schools must teach art and music.
t2.sampleA2: Some people think schools do not need art and music. But I do not agree. Art and music help students to be creative. They also help students relax. Maths and science are important too, but school is not only about exams. In conclusion, I think schools should teach art and music because they are good for students.
t2.sampleB1: Some people think schools do not need art and music because science and maths are more useful. But I do not agree. First, art and music help students to be creative, and creativity is useful in many jobs. Second, these subjects help students relax and show their feelings. Of course, maths and science are important for work. But school should help the whole student, not only exams. In conclusion, I think schools should still teach art and music because they are good for students.
t2.sampleB2: This is such a great question, and honestly it's one I feel strongly about. In my opinion, schools absolutely still need to teach art and music — perhaps now more than ever. For a start, these subjects do wonders for creativity. When you paint a picture or learn an instrument, you train your brain to think outside the box and come up with fresh ideas. That kind of creative thinking is incredibly useful, whether you end up as an engineer, a doctor or a business owner. On top of that, art and music are brilliant for our well-being. After a stressful day of maths and science, picking up a guitar or sketching something helps students relax and express how they really feel. Of course, I get the other side — some people argue that exam subjects should come first. But surely a good school should shape the whole person, not just churn out exam results? What does everyone else think? Did art or music classes make a real difference for you at school? I'd genuinely love to hear your stories in the comments below!
t2.uzSample:
San'at va musiqa maktab o'quv dasturining asosiy qismlari bo'lib qolishi kerakmi degan savol doimiy bahs-munozaralarga sabab bo'ladi, ammo men ularning o'rni har qachongidan ham muhimroq ekanligiga qat'iy ishonaman. STEM fanlari tobora ustunlik qilayotgan bir davrda, san'at fanlari <mark>ajralmas muvozanatni</mark> ta'minlab, miqdoriy jihatdan o'lchash qiyin bo'lgan, ammo har tomonlama rivojlanish uchun hayotiy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan ko'nikmalarni shakllantiradi.

Musiqa, drama va tasviriy san'at kabi fanlar, birinchi navbatda, ijodkorlik va tanqidiy fikrlashni tarbiyalash uchun asosdir. Ular o'quvchilarga dunyoni turli nuqtai nazardan tushunishni, yagona to'g'ri javobi bo'lmagan muammolarni hal qilishni va yangilik yaratishni o'rgatadi. Masalan, jazz ansamblida improvizatsiya qilishni o'rganayotgan o'quvchi har qanday professional sohaga <mark>osonlik bilan o'tkaziladigan</mark> kognitiv moslashuvchanlik va hamkorlik ko'nikmalarini rivojlantiradi.

Ikkinchidan, san'at madaniy tushunish va hissiy ifoda uchun kuchli vositadir. Ular o'quvchilarga o'z shaxsiyatini o'rganish va turli davrlar va madaniyatlardagi boshqa odamlarning nuqtai nazarlari bilan tanishish orqali empatiyani rivojlantirish uchun maydon yaratadi. <mark>Hissiy intellektni rivojlantirish</mark>, shubhasiz, akademik salohiyat kabi muhimdir.

Ba'zilar bu fanlarni natijaga yo'naltirilgan ta'lim tizimida dabdaba deb hisoblashi mumkin, ammo men ularni zaruriyat deb bilaman. Ular o'quvchilarni nafaqat ish topishga, balki <mark>to'laqonli va mazmunli hayot kechirishga</mark> tayyorlaydi.
t2.uzSampleA1: Ba'zilar maktabda san'at va musiqa muhim emas deydi. Lekin men rozi emasman. San'at va musiqa qiziqarli. Ular o'quvchilarni ijodkor va baxtli qiladi. Matematika ham muhim. Lekin maktab faqat imtihon emas. Menimcha maktablar san'at va musiqani o'qitishi kerak.
t2.uzSampleA2: Ba'zilar maktablarga san'at va musiqa kerak emas deydi. Lekin men rozi emasman. San'at va musiqa o'quvchilarga ijodkor bo'lishga yordam beradi. Ular dam olishga ham yordam beradi. Matematika va fan ham muhim, lekin maktab faqat imtihon emas. Xulosa, menimcha maktablar san'at va musiqani o'qitishi kerak, chunki ular o'quvchilar uchun foydali.
t2.uzSampleB1: Ba'zilar maktablarga san'at va musiqa kerak emas deb o'ylaydi, chunki fan va matematika foydaliroq. Lekin men rozi emasman. Birinchidan, san'at va musiqa o'quvchilarga ijodkor bo'lishga yordam beradi, va ijodkorlik ko'p kasbda foydali. Ikkinchidan, bu fanlar o'quvchilarga dam olish va his-tuyg'ularini ko'rsatishga yordam beradi. Albatta, matematika va fan ish uchun muhim. Lekin maktab butun o'quvchiga yordam berishi kerak, faqat imtihon emas. Xulosa, menimcha maktablar san'at va musiqani o'qitishi kerak, chunki ular o'quvchilar uchun foydali.
t2.uzSampleB2: Ba'zilar maktablar tasviriy san'at va musiqani o'qitishni to'xtatishi kerak, chunki bu fanlar fan yoki matematikadan kamroq foydali deb o'ylaydi. Biroq, men bunga qat'iy qarshiman. Birinchidan, san'at va musiqa ijodkorlikni rivojlantiradi, bu esa bugungi kunda deyarli har bir kasbda muhim. Ikkinchidan, bu fanlar o'quvchilarga dam olish va his-tuyg'ularini ifodalashga yordam beradi, bu ularning ruhiy holatini yaxshilaydi. Albatta, akademik fanlar kasb uchun muhim, lekin yaxshi ta'lim faqat imtihon natijalarini emas, butun shaxsni rivojlantirishi kerak. Xulosa qilib aytganda, maktablar san'at va musiqani o'qitishda davom etishi kerak, chunki ular o'quvchilarni ijodkor, muvozanatli va baxtli qiladi.

t11.title: Informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is also interested in museums. Write about the event and ask if they would like to join you.
t11.sample: Hi Alex, Hope you're well. I just received an email from the museum about a special event this Friday and thought of you immediately. They're offering guided tours and discounts in the shop, which piqued my interest. Given our shared love for history, I thought this could be a golden opportunity for a catch-up. Are you free to join? Let me know what you think. Best, Chris
t11.sampleA1: Hi Jordan, We have a museum event next Friday. There is a tour and food. You like museums. Do you want to come with me? Please tell me. Alex
t11.sampleA2: Hi Jordan, Our museum club has a special event next Friday. There is a tour and a talk about Egypt. I know you like museums. There is also food. Do you want to come with me? Please tell me soon. Alex
t11.sampleB1: Hi Jordan, I have some news. Our museum club is having a special event next Friday. There will be a guided tour and a talk about ancient Egypt. I know you like museums, so I thought of you. There will also be food. Do you want to come with me? Please tell me soon. Best wishes, Alex
t11.sampleB2: Hi Aziz, Guess what? Our museum is putting on a special event this Friday — guided tours all day and cheap books in the shop! I know you're mad about history, so I thought of you straight away. Fancy coming along with me? We could grab a coffee afterwards. Let me know! Cheers, Dilnoza Karimova
t11.uzSample:
Salom Aleks,

Umid qilamanki, ishlaring yaxshi. Hozirgina muzeydan shu juma kuni bo'lib o'tadigan maxsus tadbir haqida xat oldim va <mark>darhol seni o'yladim</mark>. Ular ekskursiyalar va do'konda chegirmalar taklif qilishmoqda, bu esa <mark>mening qiziqishimni uyg'otdi</mark>. Tarixga bo'lgan umumiy mehrimizni hisobga olib, bu diydorlashish uchun <mark>ajoyib imkoniyat</mark> bo'ladi deb o'yladim. Bo'shmisan, qo'shilasanmi? Nima deb o'ylashingni menga bildirib qo'y.

Yaxshi tilaklar bilan,

Kris
t11.uzSampleA1: Salom Jordan, kelasi juma muzey tadbiri bor. Sayohat va ovqat bor. Sen muzeylarni yaxshi ko'rasan. Men bilan borasanmi? Menga ayt. Alex
t11.uzSampleA2: Salom Jordan, muzey klubimizda kelasi juma maxsus tadbir bor. Sayohat va Misr haqida ma'ruza bo'ladi. Sen muzeylarni yaxshi ko'rasan. Ovqat ham bor. Men bilan borasanmi? Tezroq ayt. Alex
t11.uzSampleB1: Salom Jordan, menda yangilik bor. Muzey klubimiz kelasi juma kuni maxsus tadbir o'tkazadi. Sayohat va qadimgi Misr haqida ma'ruza bo'ladi. Sen muzeylarni yaxshi ko'rasan, shuning uchun seni esladim. Ovqat ham bo'ladi. Men bilan borishni xohlaysanmi? Tezroq ayt. Alex
t11.uzSampleB2: Salom Jordan, bilasanmi? Muzey klubimiz kelasi juma kuni maxsus kechki tadbir o'tkazadi — sayohat va qadimgi Misr haqida ma'ruza bo'ladi. Sen tarixni qanchalik yaxshi ko'rishingni bilaman, shuning uchun darrov seni esladim. U yerda ovqat ham bo'ladi va odatda ko'rgazmada bo'lmaydigan buyumlarni ko'rish imkoni bor. Men bilan borishni xohlaysanmi? Tezroq ayt! Alex

t12.title: Formal letter · to manager
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the museum events manager. Explain your opinion about the planned event and suggest some ideas for future museum activities.
t12.sample: Dear Events Manager, Thank you for your email regarding the special event this Friday. The planned activities are a commendable initiative; the guided tours, in particular, offer a fantastic way to engage more deeply with the exhibits. The shop discounts are also a welcome incentive for visitors. Looking ahead, I believe incorporating more interactive elements could further augment the visitor experience. For instance, organising hands-on workshops related to current exhibitions, such as pottery or printmaking, would likely prove very popular. Furthermore, hosting lectures by esteemed experts or curators could attract a dedicated audience and foster a stronger community around the museum. Thank you for considering my feedback. Yours sincerely, Alex Miller
t12.sampleA1: Dear Sir or Madam, The event next Friday is a good idea. We can see many things. I have an idea. Please do the tour two times. You can also make workshops for children. Thank you. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleA2: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about the event next Friday. I think it is a good idea. We can see rare things and learn a lot. I have some ideas too. You can do the tour at two times. For the future, you can have workshops for children. Thank you. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleB1: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about the special event next Friday. I think it is a very good idea because we can see rare things and learn from experts. But I have some ideas. Maybe you can do the tour at two times, so more members can come. For the future, the museum could have workshops for children or talks by local historians. I think many people would like this. Thank you very much. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleB2: Dear Events Manager, Thank you for your email about the special event this Friday. I would be delighted to attend, and I think the planned activities are a great idea. The guided tours are a wonderful way to explore the collection in more depth, and the discounts in the shop are a nice touch that visitors are sure to appreciate. Looking ahead, I would like to suggest a few ideas for future events. Firstly, it would be lovely to run hands-on workshops, such as painting or pottery, which would appeal to families with children. Secondly, the museum could host evening talks by local historians to attract a wider audience. An interactive exhibition using technology might also help to draw in younger visitors. Thank you for taking my feedback on board. I look forward to hearing about your plans. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli Tadbirlar Menejeri,

Ushbu juma kungi maxsus tadbir haqidagi xatingiz uchun tashakkur. Rejalashtirilgan tadbirlar — bu <mark>maqtovga sazovor tashabbus</mark>; ayniqsa, ekskursiyalar eksponatlar bilan chuqurroq tanishishning ajoyib usulini taqdim etadi. Do'kondagi chegirmalar ham tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun yoqimli rag'batdir.

Kelajakka nazar tashlaydigan bo'lsak, menimcha, ko'proq interaktiv elementlarni kiritish <mark>tashrif buyuruvchilar tajribasini yanada boyitishi</mark> mumkin. Masalan, kulolchilik yoki bosma san'ati kabi joriy ko'rgazmalarga oid <mark>amaliy mahorat darslari</mark> tashkil etish katta ehtimol bilan juda ommalashadi. Bundan tashqari, <mark>hurmatli mutaxassislar</mark> yoki kuratorlar tomonidan ma'ruzalar o'tkazish maxsus auditoriyani jalb qilishi va muzey atrofida kuchliroq hamjamiyatni shakllantirishi mumkin.

Fikr-mulohazalarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,

Aleks Miller
t12.uzSampleA1: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, kelasi juma tadbiri yaxshi g'oya. Biz ko'p narsa ko'ramiz. Menda g'oya bor. Iltimos, sayohatni ikki marta qiling. Bolalar uchun ham mashg'ulot qiling. Rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter
t12.uzSampleA2: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, kelasi juma tadbiri haqida yozmoqdaman. Menimcha, bu yaxshi g'oya. Biz noyob narsalarni ko'ramiz va ko'p narsa o'rganamiz. Menda ham g'oyalar bor. Sayohatni ikki vaqtda o'tkazsangiz bo'ladi. Kelajak uchun bolalar uchun mashg'ulotlar qiling. Rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter
t12.uzSampleB1: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, kelasi juma kungi maxsus tadbir haqida yozmoqdaman. Menimcha, bu juda yaxshi g'oya, chunki biz noyob narsalarni ko'ramiz va mutaxassislardan o'rganamiz. Lekin menda ba'zi g'oyalar bor. Balki sayohatni ikki vaqtda o'tkazarsiz, shunda ko'proq a'zo keladi. Kelajak uchun muzey bolalar uchun mashg'ulotlar yoki mahalliy tarixchilar ma'ruzasini o'tkazishi mumkin. Menimcha, ko'p odam buni yoqtiradi. Katta rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter
t12.uzSampleB2: Hurmatli janob yoki xonim, muzey klubi kelasi juma kuniga rejalashtirgan maxsus kechki tadbir yuzasidan yozmoqdaman. Menimcha, bu ajoyib g'oya, chunki a'zolarga noyob buyumlarni ko'rish va mutaxassislardan o'rganish imkonini beradi. Biroq, bir nechta taklif bermoqchiman. Sayohatni ikki xil vaqtda o'tkazish foydali bo'lardi, shunda ko'proq a'zolar qatnasha oladi. Kelajakdagi tadbirlar uchun muzey bolalar uchun mashg'ulotlar yoki mahalliy tarixchilar bilan kechki suhbatlar tashkil qilishi mumkin. Bu g'oyalar ko'proq tashrifchini jalb qiladi deb o'ylayman. Mehnatingiz uchun rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter

tasks.p1_context: You are a member of a local museum club. You received an email from the museum events manager.
tasks.p1_scenario:
Dear Member,

This Friday, the museum will organize a special event for visitors. There will be guided tours around the museum, and the museum shop will offer discounts on books and souvenirs throughout the day.

We would like to know if you are interested in joining the event. What do you think about the planned activities? Are there any other events or services you would like the museum to organize in the future?

We appreciate your feedback and suggestions.

Kind regards,

The Events Manager
